eps.d: The son of a trusted officer of the Special Branch has become radicalised while away at university.
A girl lands at Heathrow from Rhodesia, but owing to Britain's break of diplomatic relations, she has no valid passport.
Detective Sergeants Webb and Gifford go undercover to investigate a secret movement.
The Security Commission has met to consider the leak that tipped a spy during the Troika affair.
A girl being held for giving official secret documents to the Russians faces a long gaol term.
The wife of a member of the Czech embassy is caught shoplifting in London.
A British embassy in eastern europe receives a coded message to say that Jordan of Special Branch would be visiting.
A KGB officer is sent to London to co-ordinate security measures with the SB team.
Jordan finds himself in Wormwood Scrubs.
Jordan flies to Frankfurt to escort a British subject home.
An ex-colonial policeman is pressured to return to Kenya to testify at the trial of a warlord.
What appears to be a straightforward case, protecting the daughter of a foreign VIP who has entered a beauty pageant in London, turns into a nightmare for Inspector Jordan.
An accusation of theft against a highly respected Greek historian sets the Special Branch team a problem.
Inman meets the CIAs new man in London, Jordan meets an old friend from Moscow.
A scientist heading to a top secret research establishment poses a risk for Inman and his team.
The team believe Karl Peters will attempt to incite London dockworkers into taking industrial action.
Military security intercept a letter written to a serviceman which contains references to secret information.
When a Czech au-pair goes missing, the team learn her father is one of the most powerful men in the country.
Inman sends Jordan to investigate the leader of a pro- germ-warfare group.
An attractive Russian ballerina from a visiting ballet company goes missing.

Starring Derren Nesbitt, Fulton McKay and Morris Perry. In the last of the present series, Britain's top code and cypher-breaker is an expert chess player. When he has to mingle with Communist players in a tournament, Inman goes along to keep an eye on him. Moxon, meanwhile, is playing a far more dangerous game. The pawns being Jordan and a former girl friend.
DCI Alan Craven is accused of taking bribes.
Tensions mount as Craven and Haggerty are on a stakeout.
Craven busts a fraudster for carrying an unlicensed firearm and forged passport.
Haggerty's father is beaten into a coma in the latest of a series of attacks.
Special Branch officers North and Craven are asked to protect a former Nazi collaborator.
A group of London youths are linked to several deadly bombing attempts.
A junior defense minister's missing husband turns up dead.
When an ex-CID officer barricades himself and a hostage in a building with multiple bombs, Special Branch is called in.
An outspoken Hollywood actress born in the U.K. comes to star in a London play.
A physician is under surveillance as a possible security risk.
An engaged couple is under heavy surveillance. Though sceptical of their guilt, Craven pursues the case nonetheless.
A German diplomat's daughter is kidnapped by a middle eastern terrorist group. Craven and Haggerty must rescue her before she is killed.
A South African diplomat visits London, and the men of Special Branch are assigned to protect him.
Craven and Haggerty investigate a handsome photographer who takes intimate pictures of the famous.
Informed that Rehfuss, a dangerous assassin, has slipped into the country, Craven is ordered to bring him in.
Craven and Haggerty must find out who organised a jail break which allowed a dangerous traitor to escape.
The Special Branch team face an explosive situation when they are asked to find the thieves who stole a top secret weapon.
Two children run riot in the luggage department at the airport, causing a mix-up with a passenger's baggage.
